svg.aria-label: Parallel self-attention heads for sat Panel: Head A Panel: Head B Head A Source tokens in order · the, cat, sat, on, the, mat Target tokens in order · the, cat, sat, on, the, mat Query “sat” at source position 3 links to “the” at target position 1 (weight 0.052), “cat” at target position 2 (weight 0.65), “sat” at target position 3 (weight 0.192), “on” at target position 4 (weight 0.059), “the” at target position 5 (weight 0.02), “mat” at target position 6 (weight 0.027) Weights sum to about 1 per query. Head B Source tokens in order · the, cat, sat, on, the, mat Target tokens in order · the, cat, sat, on, the, mat Query “sat” at source position 3 links to “the” at target position 1 (weight 0.388), “cat” at target position 2 (weight 0.175), “sat” at target position 3 (weight 0.093), “on” at target position 4 (weight 0.049), “the” at target position 5 (weight 0.077), “mat” at target position 6 (weight 0.218) Weights sum to about 1 per query. Both queries are sat. Each head computes $a=\operatorname{softmax}(qK^{\mathsf{T}}/\sqrt{d_k})$ with $d_k=2$ in this example.
